definitionZh: padding-inline-end CSS属性定义了元素的逻辑内在端贴,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将元素映射到物理端贴.
sourceDefinition: The padding-inline-end CSS property defines the logical inline end padding of an element, which maps to a physical padding depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.
